name: Bank of Hangzhou Co., Ltd.
summary: Bank of Hangzhou Co., Ltd. provides various banking products and services in China. The company operates through five segments: Corporate Business, Small Business, Retail Business, Treasury Business, and Other Businesses. It offers deposits, loans, settlements, trade-related products, and other services; and debit cards, credit and mortgage lending, and personal asset management services. The company also provides interbank deposit/lending, repurchase/repurchase agreements, discounting, and investment. It serves individual customers, small businesses, and large and medium-sized enterprise clients. The company was formerly known as Hangzhou City Commercial Bank Co., Ltd. and changed its name …
